1. List the wavelengths and angles of the bank, and sigma for each wavelength.
2. Take the FFT of the image, extended by the largest kernel half width.
3. Correlate with every complex Gabor kernel through that spectrum, and take the magnitude.
4. Combine the magnitudes into the largest, the mean, or the angle of the strongest.
